tools: dbt Core CLI with the project's warehouse adapter

presentation.name: Choose a dbt incremental strategy and unique key
presentation.summary: Chooses an incremental strategy and unique key that survive late data and schema drift.
benefits: Matches the strategy to how the source actually changes
Handles late-arriving rows instead of silently dropping them
Detects divergence between incremental and full-refresh output
